Je DAILY RITUAL skutečná značka?: Is DAILY RITUAL a real brand?
DAILY RITUAL je fiktivní skincare koncep: DAILY RITUAL is a fictional skincare concept created for the VERBA portfolio. The name, packaging and product range demonstrate web design and development. No products are sold here.
Musí mít moje rutina všechny tři kroky?: Does my routine need all three steps?
Nemusí. Tři kroky jsou způsob, jak v tom: No. Three steps are a way of presenting care clearly within this concept. Your routine may differ depending on your skin and the products you use. Simplicity is an option here, not a rule.

Produkty jsou pouze návrhy a nemají skut: These products are design concepts with no real formulation. Their suitability for any skin type cannot be assessed. With real skincare, follow the ingredients and the manufacturer’s guidance.

Neuvádíme žádný SPF ani testované ochran: No SPF or tested protective properties are claimed. Protect is the name of a fictional category, not a promise of UV protection. For sun protection, choose a real product with a declared SPF.
